text.en: Priests wrote the history of each king on them after his death.

feedback.en: That would be a report on the past. Oracle bones hold questions, and they were often about what was still to come.

text.en: A bone was heated until it cracked, and the pattern of the cracks was read as an answer.
Traders used them to record the goods they sold.

feedback.en: That describes the oldest tablets of Sumer. Oracle bones hold questions and were read by their cracks.

text.en: They were hung up and struck to make music.

feedback.en: That is a use of carved jade pieces in China. Oracle bones were heated and read.

explanation.en: Bones and shells were heated until they cracked, and people read the cracks. The book says these oracles were often used to foretell the future.

hints.en: Think about what the heat did to the bone.
What did the diviner look at afterwards?
